sections.heading: Progress towards Apple 2030
sections.source_text:
Apple 2030 is our commitment to be carbon neutral for our entire carbon footprint. Our plan to decarbonise products is rigorous and focuses on transitioning to low-carbon electricity, designing with recycled and low-carbon materials, and prioritising lower-carbon ways of shipping products, like sea freight.
See Apple’s commitment

sections.heading: Materials
sections.source_text:
100% recycled cobalt in the battery
100% recycled copper in multiple printed circuit boards
100% recycled gold plating and tin solder in all Apple-designed printed circuit boards
100% recycled rare earth elements in all magnets
90% recycled polyester in the canopy and cushion yarn
100% recycled polyester inside the ear cushion

sections.heading: Waste
sections.source_text: No established final assembly sites generate waste sent to landfill as part of Apple’s Zero Waste Programme 15

sections.heading: Smarter chemistry 16
sections.source_text: All of the materials used in Apple products, accessories and packaging are covered by the requirements of our Regulated Substances Specification , which was one of the first in industry to restrict the use of key substances of concern. See the latest En­viron­men­tal Progress Report to understand Apple’s recent efforts in phasing out these chemistries.
